sn1.17:1.1: Dukkaraṃ duttitikkhañca || avyattena ca sāmaññaṃ || bahū hi tattha sambādhā || yattha bālo visīdatīti || ||
sn1.17:2.1: Kati-haṃ careyya sāmaññaṃ || cittaṃ ce na nivāreyya || pade pade visīdeyya || saṅkappānaṃ vasānugo || || Kummo
sn1.17:3.1: va aṅgāni sake kapāle || samodahaṃ bhikkhu mano-vitakke || anissito aññam aheṭhayāno || parinibbuto na upavadeyya kañcīti || ||
